privacy.s1_body: Pilot Finance is a personal finance simulation and budget projection tool. It does not connect to any real bank or financial institution. All data is entered manually by you: email address (for authentication), display name, and the financial projections you define (account names, balances, interest rates, recurring transactions). No data is collected automatically. No analytics or tracking is used.
privacy.s2_body: All financial data is encrypted server-side with AES-256-GCM before being stored. Your email is handled via an HMAC blind index so its plaintext value is never stored directly in the database. Pilot Finance is self-hosted: your data stays on the server operated by the instance administrator and never leaves it.
privacy.s3_body: Pilot Finance does not sell, rent, or share any of your data with third parties. No data is sent to external services, analytics platforms, or advertising networks. Your data never leaves the instance you are connected to.
privacy.s4_body: Your data is retained as long as your account exists. You may delete your account at any time from the Settings page, which permanently removes all associated data.
privacy.s5_body: You have the right to export all your data in JSON format from the Settings page. You also have the right to delete your account and all associated data at any time.
privacy.s6_body: This site uses a single session cookie (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax), strictly required for authentication. No advertising, analytics, or third-party cookies are used.
privacy.s7_body: For any privacy-related questions, please contact the administrator of this instance.

legal.s1_body: Pilot Finance is a self-hosted, open-source personal finance simulation tool. This instance is operated for personal use and is not a commercial service. It does not provide real banking, investment, or financial advisory services.
legal.s2_body: This instance is self-hosted by its administrator. All data remains on this server. For any inquiry, please contact the instance administrator directly.
legal.s3_body: This site uses a single session cookie (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax), strictly required for authentication. No advertising or analytics cookies are used.
legal.s4_body: Pilot Finance is a projection and simulation tool. The financial information displayed consists entirely of user-entered hypothetical data and computed projections. Nothing shown constitutes investment advice. The administrator cannot be held responsible for any financial decisions made based on this data.
legal.s5_body: Pilot Finance is distributed as free software. The source code is available under the terms of its license.
